content.json:
# Application Insights — End-to-End Agent Investigation
Follow customer impact from browser and request telemetry through agent, model, handoff, tool, retry, and semantic task outcomes. All lab data is synthetic and prompt/completion content recording remains disabled.

## Detect and scope
Technical success, task correctness, performance budgets, and trace completeness are independent health dimensions.

content.query: dependencies | where type == 'GenAI' and name == 'customer_support_agent' | extend Scenario=tostring(customDimensions['scenario']), Mode=tostring(customDimensions['demo.mode']), Technical=tostring(customDimensions['technical.success']), Task=tostring(customDimensions['task.success']), Performance=tostring(customDimensions['performance.success']), Trace=tostring(customDimensions['trace.complete']) | summarize Runs=count(), TechnicalFailures=countif(Technical=='false'), TaskFailures=countif(Task=='false'), PerformanceFailures=countif(Performance=='false'), IncompleteTraces=countif(Trace=='false'), P95DurationMs=percentile(duration,95) by Scenario, Mode | order by Scenario asc, Mode asc
content.title: Agent task health

content.json:
## Compare broken and fixed profiles
A fix is proven only when the same outcome, latency, retry, token, and trace-quality measurements recover.

content.query: dependencies | where type == 'GenAI' and name == 'customer_support_agent' | extend Scenario=tostring(customDimensions['scenario']), Mode=tostring(customDimensions['demo.mode']), Task=tostring(customDimensions['task.success'])=='true', Performance=tostring(customDimensions['performance.success'])=='true', Retries=toint(customDimensions['retry.count']), InputTokens=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']) | summarize Runs=count(), TaskSuccessRate=100.0*countif(Task)/count(), PerformanceSuccessRate=100.0*countif(Performance)/count(), P95DurationMs=percentile(duration,95), AvgRetries=avg(Retries), AvgInputTokens=avg(InputTokens) by Scenario, Mode | order by Scenario asc, Mode asc
content.title: Broken versus fixed evidence

content.query: dependencies | where type == 'GenAI' and name == 'customer_support_agent' | extend Scenario=tostring(customDimensions['scenario']), Mode=tostring(customDimensions['demo.mode']), Retries=toint(customDimensions['retry.count']), InputTokens=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), OutputTokens=toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']), Task=tostring(customDimensions['task.success']) | summarize Runs=count(), SuccessfulRuns=countif(Task=='true'), Retries=sum(Retries), Tokens=sum(InputTokens)+sum(OutputTokens) by Scenario, Mode | extend TokensPerSuccessfulTask=iff(SuccessfulRuns>0,todouble(Tokens)/SuccessfulRuns,real(null)) | order by TokensPerSuccessfulTask desc nulls last
content.title: Retry and token efficiency

content.json:
## Validate the customer function
The task-level availability test checks the deterministic fixed agent path, not only the web server root.

content.query: availabilityResults | summarize Runs=count(), Failures=countif(success==false), AvailabilityPct=100.0*countif(success==true)/count(), P95DurationMs=percentile(duration,95) by name, location | order by name asc, location asc
content.title: Root and agent-task availability
